system.description:
Requirements: Expertise (1) in Arcana

You have learned to control and shape your most deadly spells to avoid harming your allies.

When your spell targets an area, you can choose a number of spaces equal to your Expertise in Arcana to be unaffected by the spell.

You may choose to move the excluded spaces with a target when you cast the spell.

If you are maintaining a spell, you may reallocate the excluded spaces at any point during your turn.
